Release 1 decision: Invite-only development pilot on the ADA Cloud Run deployment path using development data and read-only MCP servers.
Reused foundation: Existing MOSAIC runtime and development environment.
Minimal new development: Complete authenticated user path and operating instructions.
Explicitly deferred: Production readiness, sensitive data and general availability.

Release 1 decision: Repository ownership is the boundary: any story that changes the MOSAIC repository is MOSAIC-owner-only. Developers work in separate application, integration and infrastructure repositories.
Reused foundation: Owner-published MOSAIC images and explicit API, configuration and validation contracts.
Minimal new development: External modules consume those contracts without importing or modifying MOSAIC code.
Explicitly deferred: Delegating any MOSAIC repository change, including backend API, identity, persistence or packaging source.

Release 1 decision: Administrator-issued opaque human tokens; browser cookie defaults to seven days.
Reused foundation: Dedicated pilot administrator secret from Secret Manager for the protected administration endpoint.
Minimal new development: Hashed user credentials, revocation, rotation, trusted request context and one removable administrator guard.

Release 1 decision: Administrators assign atomic Public Skill IDs with mosaic-admin through a protected endpoint; users receive an external spreadsheet catalogue.
Minimal new development: workspace_skills persistence plus validated set/show endpoint and CLI commands.
Explicitly deferred: Self-service catalogue, Private Skills and team visibility.

Release 1 decision: Users can create, list and reopen persistent ADK sessions; no automatic expiry.
Reused foundation: ADK SQLite SessionService and event history.
Minimal new development: Owned /api/v1 wrappers, titles and activity timestamps.
Explicitly deferred: Delete, rename, share and automated retention.

Release 1 decision: One active invocation per conversation; explicit cancellation; browser disconnect does not cancel.
Reused foundation: Existing ADA execution and SSE events.
Minimal new development: Background task registry, 409 guard, status and cancellation.
Explicitly deferred: Queues, resume after process restart and inferred topic switching.

Release 1 decision: Dash and its client-side JavaScript run as a completely separate application and communicate with MOSAIC only through /api/v1.
Reused foundation: Published MOSAIC HTTP, authentication and SSE contracts.
Minimal new development: Independent Dash repository, executable, image, configurable backend URL, sign-in, conversation navigation, chat, streaming and busy state.
Explicitly deferred: React replacement, WebSockets, Skill UI and administration UI.

Release 1 decision: Human bearer tokens use the same /api/v1 conversation API as the browser.
ADK session.db and MOSAIC mosaic.db are separate SQLite files on Terraform-managed persistent file storage mounted into one Cloud Run instance.
Reused foundation: ADK SQLite session persistence and Cloud Run NFS volume support.
Minimal new development: Terraform Filestore/NFS mount, fixed database paths, MOSAIC SQLAlchemy/Alembic schema and process-local write serialisation.
Explicitly deferred: PostgreSQL, horizontal scaling, high availability, backup and recovery targets.

Release 1 decision: Approved JSON is committed beside Terraform, uploaded as a versioned GCS object and mounted read-only by Cloud Run.
Minimal new development: Seed pilot definitions, CI validation, object versioning and a content-hash rollout trigger.

Release 1 decision: Load approved Skill packages from configurable branch main; merge means publication.
Explicitly deferred: Tags, commit pinning and progressive catalogue releases.

Release 1 decision: Shared development access with every MCP server explicitly read-only.
Minimal new development: Read-only verification and bounded failure messages.
Explicitly deferred: Delegated identity, MCP shim and platform-specific RBAC.

Release 1 decision: Release 1 has no RAG dependency. The post-release PoC runs as a separate solution and does not modify MOSAIC.
Reused foundation: ADA platform guidance, the development GCP environment and embedding models exposed through the AI access layer.
Explicitly deferred: RAG platform decision, embedding validation, ingestion and retrieval PoC, database-use-case evaluation and MOSAIC integration contract.

Release 1 decision: Single-instance Cloud Run service, mounted SQLite storage, probes, structured correlation and README pilot runbook; no production resilience guarantee.
Reused foundation: Existing GCP/ADA logging, Artifact Registry, Cloud Run and Terraform workflow.
Minimal new development: Cloud Run runtime settings, volume mount, startup/readiness checks, rollout/rollback and operating instructions.
Explicitly deferred: Dashboards, alerts, retention, chargeback and production rate limiting.
